title: Review route missing response model
why: An undocumented response shape weakens validation and the generated OpenAPI contract.
suggestion: Declare response_model or a precise return annotation.
limitations: Explicit route decorators and object-shaped returns are inspected for response_model or recognized return annotations, including bare dict, parameterized dict/list, and capitalized model types. Annotation aliases and model definitions are not resolved.
Framework wrappers, generated routes, runtime registrations, and external infrastructure cannot be resolved.
